records.title: Intensive Elementary Modern Greek

records.text: JSIS E 134 Intensive Elementary Modern Greek (15) Develops a basic level of proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing skills in Greek as it is used today. records.title: Second-Year Modern Greek
records.header: JSIS E 211 Second-Year Modern Greek (5) A&H
records.text: JSIS E 211 Second-Year Modern Greek (5) A&H Intensive practice in speaking, reading, and writing. Explores topics like news, history, health, politics, and social justice while incorporating cultural themes. Grammar focuses on tenses, pronouns, adjectives, verbs, and the imperative mood to build comprehension and communication skills. Prerequisite: JSIS E 113. Offered: ASp.

records.title: Second-Year Modern Greek
records.header: JSIS E 212 Second-Year Modern Greek (5) A&H
records.text: JSIS E 212 Second-Year Modern Greek (5) A&H Intensive practice in speaking, reading, and writing. Focuses on practical topics such as introductions, directions, family interactions, and telling time while incorporating complex literature to deepen cultural understanding. Grammar focuses on including auxiliary verbs, pronouns, possessive forms, and verb conjugations. Reinforces learning with real-life application through conversation and exercises. Prerequisite: JSIS E 211. Offered: WSp.

records.title: Second-Year Modern Greek
records.header: JSIS E 213 Second-Year Modern Greek (5) A&H
records.text: JSIS E 213 Second-Year Modern Greek (5) A&H Intensive practice in speaking, reading, and writing. Covers a wide range of practical topics, from neighborhood interactions to holiday planning. Key grammar lessons include irregular verb conjugations, comparative and superlative adjectives, tenses, participles in the active voice, uncommon nouns, and adjectives. Prerequisite: JSIS E 212. Offered: Sp.
